stories.title: Democrat Chuck Hubbard wins recount in North Carolina US House race, unseats Republican Rep. Virginia Foxx
stories.summary: Democratic Chuck Hubbard will win the election in North Carolina's 5th congressional district, the Associated Press projects.

stories.title: US Army plans to invoke emergency provisions to detonate bomb-making chemicals in Iowa
stories.summary: The Army said it plans to invoke emergency provisions to detonate bomb-making chemicals Wednesday in Iowa "to allow for optimal weather conditions" and for all mitigation measures to be put in place.

stories.title: Suspect arrested following shooting that left 1 man hospitalized, Lemoore police say
stories.summary: A suspect has been arrested for allegedly shooting a man Saturday afternoon in Lemoore.

stories.title: Tulare County Sheriff's Office releases new details after 9 people shot at private concert
stories.summary: The Tulare County Sheriff's Office shared new details Sunday about a shooting that sent nine people to the hospital Saturday night.

stories.title: Automation system problem at Delta causes flight delays as Americans travel for Thanksgiving
stories.summary: An issue with Delta Air Lines’ weight and balance automation system was causing flight delays Sunday at its hub in Atlanta and nationwide.

stories.title: Children First: Decoding Our Digital World

stories.title: Mt. Whitney High School students build robots and career skills through computer science academy
stories.summary: Mt. Whitney High School students are getting the chance to have hands-on experience with robotics, coding and AI.

stories.title: Driver found dead after vehicle crashes into tree in Visalia, police say
stories.summary: A person has died in a solo-vehicle accident after crashing into a tree in Visalia.

stories.title: Appeals court says federal law requiring accommodations for pregnant workers is unconstitutional

stories.summary: Participating nations in the U.N. COP31 climate conference failed to reach consensus on fossil fuels, finance and other issues.
